text:
Fiona L: opening thread for follow-ups after the 03:15UTC rollout hiccup. saw retry bursts and TLS handshakes failing for a subset of clients. looks like a routing bug where old backend IPs lingered in lb sticky maps while certs rotated.
Gabe R: timeline? which traffic paths?
Fiona L: 03:12-03:22 UTC. predominant path: na-east1 -> eu-west3. RouteGroup-C had stale mappings after the rollout step that updated certs but not cache entries.
Hanna C: quick triage: when certs bound to new IPs, some edge proxies continued sending traffic to v1 IPs which no longer had the TLS cert for the requested SNI -> handshake fails and client retries. likely race between bind-update and cache-invalidation.
Gabe R: immediate action checklist I propose: 1) emergency cache invalidation command for RouteGroup-C, 2) add pre-rollout parity check between bind state and LB maps, 3) instrument a metric for "tls.bind_mismatch" and alert, 4) add a recurring incident-pattern ticket to review similar cases.
Hanna C: I'll take #1 and #3. Adding flush command to runbook and creating a simple metric that increments when we detect cert mismatch in ingress logs. ETA flush + runbook: 3h. ETA metric + alert: EOD.
Gabe R: I'll own #2 and #4. Plan: a CI smoke that queries bind-state API and lb map API and fails rollout if differences present. Also creating NET-499: "tls-bind vs lb-map parity checks" for recurring reviews.
Fiona L: @infra-bot can we schedule a post-fix canary in eu-west3 to validate both bind and routing?
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: postbind-validate-2026-03-29-05:30 (eu-west3). Results will be posted here.
SRE Oncall: manual sanity checks if you want to validate quickly:
```
# check bind vs map
curl -sS https://binds.redwood.internal/routes/routegroup-c | jq '.addresses'
curl -sS https://lbmaps.redwood.internal/routegroup-c | jq '.addresses'
# test SNI cert via specific IPs
curl -v --resolve api.routegroup-c.redwood.internal:443:198.51.100.10 https://api.routegroup-c.redwood.internal/health
```
Gabe R: created NET-499: "tls-bind vs lb-map parity checks" assigned to Networking. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-499
Hanna C: Example log snippet I pulled showing mismatch detection:
```
2026-03-29T03:14:35Z ingress[proxy-12] ERROR tls: sni mismatch for client=10.0.2.45 requested=api.routegroup-c redir_ip=198.51.100.10 cert_bound=198.51.100.20
tls.bind_mismatch: true
```
Fiona L: owners recap:
- Hanna C: emergency cache invalidation + runbook + tls.bind_mismatch metric 3h / EOD for alert
- Gabe R: CI parity checks + NET-499 + recurring review cadence d to get into CI smoke
- SRE Oncall: watch `tls.bind_mismatch` and canary results for 48h
Gabe R: Added runbook flush example: `./tools/cache-invalidate --group routegroup-c --force` and a pre-rollout script: `./tools/parity-check --group routegroup-c`
SRE Oncall: Canary initial: 6/6 health checks green over 20m, no further handshake errors. Will keep dashboards up for 72h.
Fiona L: thanks team. we'll reconvene in 48h to close or list follow-ups. keeping thread as action tracker. :white_check_mark:
